trials.final_answer:

| Issue | Recommended action | |-------|--------------------| | **Failed (OTP timeout / insufficient funds)** | • Contact the customer to retry payment or provide an alternate method.
• Check Razorpay logs for the exact failure reason if you need more detail. | | **Cancelled** | • Verify whether the cancellation was intentional (customer request) or accidental.
• If the customer still wants the product, ask them to place a new order. | | **On‑hold (risk review)** | • Review the risk‑review notes in Razorpay.
• If the order is legitimate, manually capture the payment or mark the order as “processing”. | | **Pending** | • Usually means the payment gateway hasn’t sent a confirmation yet.
• Wait a few minutes; if it stays pending, reach out to the customer or check webhook status. | | **Refunded** | • No further action needed unless the refund was issued in error. | | **Partial refund (order 25)** | • Confirm the customer is satisfied with the partial refund.
